reading.body:
Tempus is a public for-profit company offering AI applied to precision medicine, with products spanning genomic data analysis, clinical trial matching, and genetic privacy considerations under GINA.

The single product recorded here, Tempus AI, sits in the Healthcare and Life Sciences category. That placement matters because medical AI of this kind is compute-intensive at the inference stage, running against large genomic datasets, but its infrastructure demands are shaped more by data licensing, regulatory compliance, and laboratory integration than by the raw power scaling that defines frontier model training. The data does not include revenue, model architecture, data center footprint, or energy consumption, so no claims about compute scale can be made from it.

What the record establishes is organizational: Tempus is publicly traded under the ticker TEM, with a CIK on file, and its profile was verified as of September 2026. It does not cover partnerships, customer count, or the size of the genomic dataset the product operates against. Readers seeking to understand where Tempus sits in the compute or power supply chain will need sources beyond what is recorded here.
